content.text:
The site matches the approved screenshots again. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) pass. There was only one commit to compare against, so I found the causes by measuring the page against the approved screenshots. I found three, all in `site/css/styles.css`:

1. **Hero button too tall:** `.btn-xl` padding was `1.875rem 2.5rem`. I set it back to `1.25rem 2.5rem`, which fixed the extra 20px of height on desktop.
2. **Phone hero text spacing:** the `.masthead-subheading` line-height was `0.75rem`. I set it back to `1.5rem`, which fixed the remaining 12px of height on phone.
3. **Squarish images:** `.rounded-circle` had `border-radius: 25%`, so the timeline and team photos looked like rounded squares. I set it back to `50%`.

I didn't commit anything.
